newsitem.title: USA: Guarantee Life Cos Inc Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Guarantee Life Cos Inc Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 Q4 net before realized gains and deferred acquisition costs amortization totaled $3.6 million or $0.36 a share vs $1.8 million or $0.18 a share in 1995 Q4 period.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 year net excluding realized investment gains and related deferred acquisition costs amortization totaled $14.9 million or $1.50 a share vs $10.4 million or $1.05 in the 1996 year.

1995 year net includes loss from discontinued operations of $1.7 million, extraordinary income charge from demutualization of $7.7 million and provision for mutual company equity add-on taxes of $1 million.
